proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.crit_immunity_against_wearer
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing passive magic-item family fits, but the surface has no honest way to encode a wearer-side replacement that downgrades incoming critical hits to normal hits. `modify_crit_range` only models changing the threshold on attack rolls, which is the wrong direction and would produce a misleading trace.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

notes: Adamantine Armor is structurally a passive magic item, but its core rider is not representable in the current effect surface. No Dhall/JSON content artifact was authored because forcing `modify_crit_range` here would be dishonest.
